notes: The exact mappings below follow the canonical IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador API header. The scenario uses an adapter-FOM object-class/directed-interaction association, succeeds with each overload while joined, then checks FederateNotExecutionMember for the same valid handles after resignation while the connection remains open. Region-qualified APIs are outside this slice.

requirements.statement: The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for publishObjectClassDirectedInteractions. The test successfully publishes the valid adapter-FOM object-class/interaction-class association while joined, then verifies that exception after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for the set overload of unpublishObjectClassDirectedInteractions. The test successfully unpublishes the valid associated interaction set while joined, then verifies that exception after resignation with the same handles.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for the whole-class overload of unpublishObjectClassDirectedInteractions. The test successfully invokes this overload for a valid adapter-FOM object class while joined, then verifies that exception after resignation.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for subscribeObjectClassDirectedInteractions. The test successfully subscribes to the valid associated interaction set with the non-universal form while joined, then verifies that exception after resignation with the same handles.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for the set overload of unsubscribeObjectClassDirectedInteractions. The test successfully unsubscribes the valid associated interaction set while joined, then verifies that exception after resignation with the same handles.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for the whole-class overload of unsubscribeObjectClassDirectedInteractions. The test successfully invokes this overload for a valid adapter-FOM object class while joined, then verifies that exception after resignation.
